criteria.title: Accountable recovery receipts

intent.request: Each affected recovery filing exposes its current accountable disposition.

criteria.model: Each affected recovery filing exposes its current accountable disposition.

criteria.method: Inspect work_items:get for WI-9999934, EI-26780389938506704, WI-6554700010020527, WI-6554700010017914 and WI-6554700010009934. Each nonterminal filing must retain an accountable executor and an executable next action, or name the unresolved dependency and its holder. A terminal filing passes only when its terminal record names the ending disposition and no continuation is owed; retain a legitimate archived-subject drop without reopening it. A LIVE_GATE_OPS next action must name its registered dependency holder instead of assigning that lane to this plan. Preserve original native/historical scope restrictions and immutable test outcomes. criteria.method: For every path in the Conformance footprint (packages/operator-core/lib/plan-acceptance-gate.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/rubrics.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/acceptance-bar-lifecycle-evaluator.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/plans/acceptance-drain-filing.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/plan-items/plan-drain-rule.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/events/builtin-actions.ts), read dev:pipeline_position with testClass operator-api. Query plans:get with shipReadiness:true for plan-shipping-friction-repair-2026-10-26 on the measured operator. criteria.title: Honest shipment status

intent.request: Final shipment is reported only from evidence on the shipped release artifact.

criteria.method: Final shipment only: retain state:read deploy.3070.sha and the /api/health serving sha for the exact release-operator artifact. For every path in the Conformance footprint, require dev:pipeline_position positions.deployed containment and serving.startedSinceCodeChange for the selected release runtime; record the six individual observations. Query plans:get with shipReadiness:true for plan-shipping-friction-repair-2026-10-26 on the measured operator. While pre-grading is blocked, require acceptance_bar_contract_not_ready with a phase-specific next repair; never acceptance_rubric_missing for the existing rubric and never an author-verdict repair while pre-grading blocks.
